summary: A mixed legal and retail day, led by Delhi High Court's AI deepfake ruling on personality rights, Sebi's proposed derivatives settlement changes, and Reliance's $1.3 billion rupee bond issuance—India's largest since 2023.

bullets.text: Delhi High Court bars misuse of AI deepfakes infringing personality rights, setting precedent on synthetic media liability.
Sebi proposes changes to expiry-day settlement pricing for derivatives and continuous trading session timing.
Reliance Industries to raise $1.3 billion via 5-year rupee bond sale—first major issuance since 2023.
Vadilal Enterprises blocks renewal of 10-year distribution agreement with ice cream maker Vadilal Industries.
Consumer startups raised Rs 300+ crore in funding this week, with FMCG brands capturing Rs 30+ crore combined.
